stem: Frank and his family drove 6 hours every day during a road trip. Which graph best represents y, the total number of hours driven in x days?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with points (0,0), (1,8), (2,16) going steeply up

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with points (0,0), (1,4.5), (2,9), (3,13.5), (4,18) going diagonally up

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with a horizontal line at y=6 from x=0 to x=4

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with a line descending from (0,6) to (4,0)

visual_elements: Four coordinate plane graphs labeled Road Trip, each with x axis labeled Number of Days from 0 to 4 and y axis labeled Total Number of Hours Driven from 0 to 16.
notes: Options A, B, C, and D correspond to four different linear graphs showing total hours driven y vs. number of days x.
